protocol.name: label_blind_shift_window_sensitivity
protocol.canonical_sampling: global feature-hash cap independent of labels
protocol.source_role_allocation: label-blind 70/30 source split; validation split into calibration/audit/mixture roles without labels
protocol.target_usage: Unlabeled scoring only; labels not loaded by the detector

metrics.not_applicable_reason: This unsupervised shift-detector comparison does not emit class probabilities or attack labels.

domain_shift_validation.scope_note: Comparison detects covariate mismatch only; it neither classifies attacks nor establishes deployment remediation.

efficiency.measurement: Detector-comparison scoring duration is reported at experiment level; no classifier artifact is serialized.

notes: The global canonical cap, source split, source validation roles, target cap, and mixture windows are label-blind.
JSD, PSI, and KS use identical source reference, calibration, audit, target, and mixture windows within each seed.
Target labels are not accessed for detector fitting, calibration, scoring, or threshold selection; recorded class counts are provenance only.
The primary JSD method and criterion were frozen in configuration before this runner is executed.
